notes.title: New Update is out, Bug Fixes, Russian Version
notes.notes: Russian Language support is added. Some bugs reported by community are fixed. Autohint can now be disabled from options button.

notes.title: Russian Version Coming Soon
notes.notes: Tower of God will soon have a Russian version update! In addition, some community demanded fixes are also in. Hope you like it!

notes.title: Tower Of God : One Wish will release on 17 Jan 2020 on Steam
notes.notes:
Legends say that the one who succeeds in climbing the tower of God will be granted a wish. Will you be the one to succeed?

Tower of God is a match-3 game with fun mechanics and enjoyable Game play. The levels are varied and fun. The game also includes mini-games such as Hidden Object, Jigsaw, Memory and Slider.

Wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1199010/Tower_Of_God_One_Wish/
